text:
Predicates:
Private(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
Moved(x, y, z) ::: x moved to y in z.
Endowment(x, y) ::: x's endowment was valued at y.
Organized(x, y) ::: x has been organized into y constituent colleges and schools.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college.
Premises:
Private(yale) ∧ IvyLeague(yale) ∧ ResearchUniversity(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
Moved(yale, newHaven, 1716) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
Endowment(yale, 42.3billion) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
Organized(yale, 27) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = benjaminFranklinCollege) ::: Benjamin Franklin College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = berkeleyCollege) ::: Berkeley College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = branfordCollege) ::: Branford College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = davenportCollege) ::: Davenport College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = ezraStilesCollege) ::: Ezra Stiles College is a residential college at Yale.

∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = jonathanEdwardsCollege) ::: Jonathan Edwards College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = morseCollege) ::: Morse College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = pauliMurrayCollege) ::: Pauli Murray College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = piersonCollege) ::: Pierson College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = saybrookCollege) ::: Saybrook College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = sillimanCollege) ::: Silliman College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = timothyDwightCollege) ::: Timothy Dwight College is a residential college at Yale.
∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ x = trumbullCollege) ::: Trumbull College is a residential college at Yale.
Conclusion:
∃x (Private(x) ∧ IvyLeague(x) ∧ ResearchUniversity(x) ∧ Moved(x, newHaven, 1716)) ::: A private Ivy League research university moved to New Haven.
